title: AdaptEvo: Adaptive Agent Learning with Evolving Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2610.11354v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rule-governed contextual decision tasks require models to apply specified rules to case-specific context and evidence. Written rules can leave gaps in decision guidance and process evaluation, while reference judgments vary in their support from the rules and evidence. To address these challenges, we introduce AdaptEvo, a framework for learning under imperfect supervision that couples confidence-adaptive policy optimization with evolving decision knowledge and evaluation rubrics. Its Training module uses Confidence-Adaptive GRPO (CA-GRPO) to balance outcome and process rewards according to reference confidence. Its Evolution module synthesizes reusable decision knowledge from recurring failures across training cases and refines process rubrics to detect overlooked errors. translated_title: AdaptEvo：具有演化监督的自适应智能体学习
translated_abstract: 遵循规则的情境化决策任务要求模型将指定规则应用于具体案例的情境与证据。然而，书面规则可能在决策指导和过程评估方面留下空白，而参考判断对规则和证据的支持程度也各不相同。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了AdaptEvo，一个在不完美监督下进行学习的框架，它将置信度自适应的策略优化与不断演化的决策知识和评估标准相结合。其训练模块采用置信度自适应GRPO（CA-GRPO），根据参考置信度来平衡结果奖励与过程奖励。其演化模块从训练案例中反复出现的失败里综合出可复用的决策知识，并细化过程评估标准，以发现此前被忽视的错误。为了支持实证评估，我们构建了一个工业级多模态内容审核数据集，包含训练集以及期内和期外测试集
tldr: AdaptEvo提出了一个在不完美监督下学习的智能体框架，通过置信度自适应GRPO平衡结果与过程奖励，并从反复失败中演化出可复用的决策知识和更精细的过程评估标准，同时在工业级多模态内容审核数据集上验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: AdaptEvo is a framework for agent learning under imperfect supervision that couples Confidence-Adaptive GRPO with evolving decision knowledge and process rubrics, validated on an industrial multimodal content moderation dataset.
